title: uw-flow/1 — Warband mod flow for graph_viewer
description: Produced by universal_warband (`uw graph --json`; py/flow_export.py writes the same). Compatibility: within uw-flow/1 fields are only ADDED, never renamed, removed or retyped; a viewer must ignore unknown fields and render unknown `kind` / `op` values generically. A breaking change gets a new format string (uw-flow/2).

roots.description: Default starting points of the view (where the game itself starts a flow).

id.description: A node id that exists in `nodes`.

nodes.description: Every node id is unique. Every edge's `from` and `to` is a node id.

id.description: Unique; what a modder writes (menu_x, script_x, screen:map).

kind.description: menu | script | mission_template | scene | presentation | screen | other (more later).

index.description: Position in its game table; -1 for stubs.

text.description: In-game text; may be empty. `^` = line break, `{s10}` `{reg0}` `{!}` are game markup.

source.description: file:line in the Module System; may be empty.

stub.description: true = only an arrow target, no details yet (draw small).

index.description: 0-based order inside the node; unique within the node (ids may repeat).

conditional.description: Shown only when a condition holds.

condition.description: Optional. When the button is shown (empty = always).

does.description: Optional. What pressing it does, statement by statement.

summary_tr.description: Optional (added 2026-11-15). One-line plain Turkish: what this is. May be empty.

detail_tr.description: Optional. 2-4 sentences: what it does, who opens/calls it.

confidence.description: Optional. yuksek | orta | dusuk (how sure the description is); empty if none.

on_enter_does.description: Optional. The opening code, statement by statement.

via_option.description: Button id, null = the node's opening code.

option_index.description: Index of that button in the from-node's options; null = opening code.

statement.description: One statement of the game code, in order.

args.description: Arguments as written in the kit: "$global", ":local", "trp_player", numbers as digits.

not.description: neg| flag: the condition is negated.

or_next.description: this_or_next| flag: OR with the next statement.

text_tr.description: Plain Turkish meaning of the operation; may be empty.
